items.title: Google says it's going to shut off Google Assistant on smart speakers next year
items.rationale: Official end-of-life for Assistant on Nest speakers forces every smart-home owner onto Gemini; concrete, dated, wide impact.

items.title: Nothing's AI device debuts December 8, and it looks like two vapes stuck together
items.excerpt: Thanks, Swedish House Mafia. I guess.
items.rationale: Follow-up to the 11-05 teaser with a new announcement: confirmed Dec 8 launch date and first look at the hardware design.

items.title: Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 3) review: Minor upgrades that cost too much
items.excerpt: Meta's very best AI glasses are only slightly better than other recent models.
items.rationale: First full review of Meta's flagship AI glasses; a buying verdict on the category leader, not covered before in this section.

items.title: Phison details SSD with a built-in NPU and 64GB of memory that supports AI frameworks on the drive
items.excerpt: Phison showed a computational-storage SSD with an NPU and 64GB of memory, plus Mixed Media pSLC and QLC drives, at SC26.
items.rationale: New hardware class: an SSD that runs PyTorch and llama.cpp on-drive, relevant to local-AI builders.

items.title: InsBotics' Pophie AI Robot Remembers Your Family and Speaks First
items.excerpt: Meet Pophie, an AI companion robot from InsBotics designed to remember your family and start conversations without waiting for you to speak.
items.rationale: New consumer companion robot with proactive, memory-based conversation; adds a home-robot angle to the set.

https://www.engadget.com/2323187/nothing.new_action: Nothing announced the launch date (December 8) and revealed the device's design; the 11-05 card was only a teaser with no date or look.
